This vacancy is for a Data Scientist (Recent Graduate) position in the Human Resources Division located at the U.S. Census Bureau Headquarters in Suitland, Maryland. The Census Bureau is accessible from the Metro Rail Green Line - Suitland Station.

This Job Opportunity Announcement may be used to fill other Data Scientist (Recent Graduate), 1560-7/9, FPL GS-13, positions within the Census Bureau in the same geographical location with the same qualifications and specialized experience.

Join Amgen’s Mission of Serving Patients

At Amgen, if you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission—to serve patients living with serious illnesses—drives all that we do.

Since 1980, we’ve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world’s toughest diseases. With our focus on four therapeutic areas –Oncology, Inflammation, General Medicine, and Rare Disease– we reach millions of patients each year. Amgen is advancing a broad and deep pipeline of medicines to treat cancer, heart disease, inflammatory conditions, rare diseases, and obesity and obesity-related conditions. As a member of the Amgen team, you’ll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives.

Our award-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, you’ll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.

Data Scientist

As a Data Scientist, you will design, develop, and implement scalable data engineering, machine learning (ML), and analytics solutions that accelerate Clinical Development and advance therapies for patients.

You will act in support the Center for Design & Analysis, partnering with data scientists and cross-functional teams to translate business requirements into robust data pipelines, analytical tools, and visualization solutions. You will contribute to the implementation and continuous improvement of innovative analytics capabilities, helping to optimize methods, algorithms, and processes while ensuring solutions are reliable, scalable, and aligned with Amgen's quality and compliance standards.

Responsibilities:
• Collaborating with research scientist and other data scientists to develop AI and advanced analytics solution to speed drug research and development.
• Designing, writing, and testing data / ML pipelines and other advanced analytic / visualization solutions
• Collect business requirements / user stories for new or enhancements to existing analytic solutions
• Train users in the use of solutions provided by the CfDA Data Science organization
• Contribute to process improvement initiatives
• Adhere to Amgen Policies, SOPs, and other controlled documents.
• Participate in the development and review of CfDA Data Sciences Policies, SOPs, and other controlled documents.
• Participate in external professional organizations, conferences and/or meetings.

Accountabilities:
• Contribute to the implementation of internally developed and externally provided analytic solutions
• Participate in the development of innovative and effective approaches to solve client's analytics problems and communicate results & methodologies
• Recommend ongoing improvements to methods and algorithms that generate analytic insights

• Entrepreneurial mindset with ability to self-direct

What you can expect of us

As we work to develop treatments that take care of others, we also work to care for your professional and personal growth and well-being. From our competitive benefits to our collaborative culture, we’ll support your journey every step of the way.

Data Scientist, Senior
The Opportunity:

As a data scientist, you’re excited at the prospect of unlocking the secrets held by a data set, and you’re fascinated by the possibilities presented by IoT, machine learning, and artificial intelligence. In an increasingly connected world, massive amounts of structured and unstructured data open new opportunities. As a data scientist at Booz Allen, you can help turn these complex data sets into useful information to solve global challenges. Across private and public sectors—from fraud detection to cancer research to national intelligence—we need you to help find the answers in the data.

On our team, you’ll use your leadership skills and data science expertise to create real-world impact. You’ll work closely with clients to understand their questions and needs and then dig into their data-rich environments to find the pieces of their information puzzle. You’ll guide teammates and lead the development of algorithms and systems. You’ll use the right combination of tools and frameworks to turn sets of disparate data points into objective answers to advise your clients as they make informed decisions. Ultimately, you’ll provide a deep understanding of the data, what it all means, and how it can be used.

Work with us as we use data science for good.

Join us. The world can’t wait.

You Have:

• 5+ years of experience using data science programming languages, such as Python or R

• Experience creating ETL pipelines, including querying APIs, cleaning and conditioning data, and creating schemas for data storage

• Experience with version control tools, including Git, GitLab, GitHub, or Bitbucket

• Knowledge of statistical analysis, predictive modeling, and machine learning methods

• Ability to design and develop automated analytic software, techniques, and algorithms

• Ability to develop solutions and integrate and extend free and open-source software (FOSS) or COTS products

• Ability to generate data visualizations with tools, such as Kibana, Tableau, or Power BI

• Active TS/SCI clearance; willingness to take a polygraph exam

• Bachelor’s degree

Nice If You Have:

• Experience working with GEOINT, HUMINT, MASINT, OSINT, and SIGINT, and the data and tools associated with these disciplines

• Experience with intelligence or operations analysis in the DoD or Intelligence Community

• Experience developing and implementing ontological frameworks

• Experience in the development of algorithms leveraging R, Python, or SQL and NoSQL

• Experience working with Deep Learning and AI frameworks, including PyTorch, TensorFlow, and Keras

• Experience working with Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) and Large Language Models (LLM)

• Experience with distributed data and computing tools, including MapReduce, Hadoop, Hive, EMR, Kafka, Spark, Gurobi, or MySQL

• Experience with visualization packages, including Plotly, Seaborn, or ggplot2

• Knowledge of DevOps, including CI/CD pipelines and Jenkins

• TS/SCI clearance with a polygraph

Clearance:

Applicants selected will be subject to a security investigation and may need to meet eligibility requirements for access to classified information; TS/SCI clearance is required.

Description

Turn Mission Data into Mission Advantage.

Are you ready to turn complex data into insights that drive mission-critical decisions? We are looking for an exceptional Data Scientist Subject Matter Expert (SME) to join the Chinook Program and help shape the future of an advanced application supporting an Intelligence Community (IC) customer.

This is an exciting opportunity for a highly accomplished data science leader who thrives on solving difficult problems, discovering patterns hidden within complex datasets, and transforming analytical insights into operational capabilities. You will work at the intersection of data science, software engineering, artificial intelligence, machine learning, analytics, and mission operations to develop innovative solutions that make a measurable difference.

As a Data Scientist SME, you will lead the design, development, evaluation, and operationalization of sophisticated data science capabilities. The role requires a combination of deep technical expertise, analytical rigor, software engineering understanding, and the ability to translate complex mission requirements into actionable data-driven solutions.

The successful candidate will work closely with software engineers, data engineers, system engineers, DevSecOps engineers, UI/UX professionals, product owners, test engineers, program leadership, and intel customer stakeholders.

The position requires an individual who can operate at both the strategic and hands-on levels establishing data science strategy while remaining technically engaged in solving complex analytical and engineering challenges.

Position may be performed in the following locations below.
• Tucson, AZ
• Gaithersburg
• Alexandria, VA
• Chantilly, VA
• Englewood, CO
• St. Louis, MO

Clearance Level Required:

Active Top Secret/SCI clearance with the ability to successfully pass a Polygraph examination.

Primary Responsibilities:
• Serve as the senior technical authority for data science, advanced analytics, and AI/ML, translating mission needs into actionable analytical solutions.
• Lead the design, development, validation, and optimization of statistical, predictive, prescriptive, and machine learning models.
• Analyze complex, heterogeneous datasets to identify patterns, anomalies, trends, and insights that support mission objectives.
• Drive the development and operationalization of AI/ML capabilities, including classification, regression, clustering, anomaly detection, NLP, and predictive modeling.
• Establish standards and best practices for model performance, validation, explainability, bias, uncertainty, reproducibility, and operational effectiveness.
• Partner with data, software, and systems engineers to define data requirements, feature engineering, data quality, governance, and scalable integration approaches.
• Collaborate with engineering and DevSecOps teams to transition analytical solutions into secure, maintainable, scalable production capabilities and CI/CD pipelines.
• Support Agile and SAFe planning and execution by translating data science initiatives into capabilities, stories, technical enablers, dependencies, and risks.
• Lead technical reviews, trade studies, and working sessions, and establish methodologies, patterns, and practices across the program.
• Engage with customers, stakeholders, and leadership to communicate findings, recommendations, risks, and mission impact.
• Mentor data scientists, engineers, and other technical team members, and review analytical approaches, code, models, and documentation.
• Evaluate and recommend emerging data science and AI/ML technologies to improve application capabilities and mission outcomes.

Basic Qualifications:
• US citizenship is required per contract
• Bachelor’s degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Geospatial Science or related field and 12-15 years of prior relevant experience or Master’s with 10-13 years of prior relevant experience. May possess a Doctorate in technical domain.
• 12+ years demonstrated experience working as a Data Scientist, Senior/Principal Data Scientist, Machine Learning Engineer, or equivalent senior technical role.
• Extensive experience applying statistical analysis, machine learning, and advanced analytics to complex problems.
• Proven expertise in developing and implementing machine learning and AI models, particularly in context of geospatial or remote sensing.
• Deep knowledge of geospatial analytics tools (e.g., GIS, ArcGIS), remote sensing techniques, and the application of data science in the IC.
• Expert proficiency in Python and/or R (or similar languages) and experience with data science libraries (Pandas, NumPy, SciPy, Scikit-learn, TensorFlow, PyTorch, or equivalent tecchnologies).
• Strong experience with big data processing tools (e.g., Spark, PySpark, Kafka, Hadoop, AWS or Azure cloud platforms).
• Expertise in working with geospatial data formats (e.g., GeoTIFF, Shapefiles, WMS, WFS) and spatial libraries (e.g., GeoPandas, Rasterio, GDAL).
• Advance experience in developing and operationalizing AI/ML models and algorithms for geospatial data (e.g., object detection from satellite imagery, spatial clustering, predictive analytics).
• Strong background in data visualization and reporting tools (e.g., Tableau, PowerBI).
• Strong leadership, communication, and collaboration skills, with the ability to work directly with senior government officials, analysts, and technical teams.
• Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills with a demonstrated ability to translate technical challenges into actionable insights.

Preferred Qualifications:
• Advanced certifications in data science or machine learning.
• Familiarity with the customer’s mission and specific geospatial intelligence challenges.
• Expertise in advanced deep learning techniques, particularly in computer vision and image analysis for geospatial applications.
• Experience with cloud-native applications and distributed computing in a geospatial context.
• Experience deploying models into production environments.
• Experience with Kubernetes and containerized applications.
• Experience developing REST APIs or other services for analytic capabilities.
• Experience with NLP and/or LLM.
• Experience with geospatial analytics and spatial data.
• Experience with streaming or near-real time analytics.
• Experience with developing analytical capabilities within secure or air-gapped environments.
• Published research or technical papers in geospatial intelligence, machine learning, or data science.

What are Trust Fund Positions?

Trust Fund positions are unique to the Smithsonian. They are paid for from a variety of sources, including the Smithsonian endowment, revenue from our business activities, donations, grants and contracts. Trust employees are not part of the civil service, nor does trust fund employment lead to Federal status. The salary ranges for trust positions are generally the same as for federal positions and in many cases trust and federal employees work side by side. Trust employees have their own benefit program, which may include Health, Dental & Vision Insurance, Life Insurance, Transit/Commuter Benefits, Accidental Death and Dismemberment Insurance, Annual and Sick Leave, Family Friendly Leave, 403b Retirement Plan, Discounts for Smithsonian Memberships, Museum Stores and Restaurants, Credit Union, Smithsonian Early Enrichment Center (Child Care), Flexible Spending Account (Health & Dependent Care).

• Complete a Probationary Period.

• The position is open to all candidates eligible to work in the United States. Proof of eligibility to work in U.S. is not required to apply.

• Applicants must meet all qualification and eligibility requirements within 30 days of the closing date of this announcement.

OVERVIEW
This position is located in Washington, DC, within the Forest Global Earth Observatory (ForestGEO), Smithsonian Tropical Research Institute (STRI), under the Office of the Under Secretary for Science and Research at the Smithsonian Institution (SI).

STRI provides a global platform for research on tropical forests and marine ecosystems, biodiversity, and human well-being.

The ForestGEO program is a global network of scientists and forest research sites dedicated to advancing the long-term study of the world's forests.

The GEO-TREES initiative builds on this network to improve the accuracy and verification of global forest carbon estimates through collaboration among forest research sites worldwide. The Data Scientist supports the Forest Global Earth Observatory (ForestGEO) and GEO-TREES programs as a liaison between site-based data collection and the development of analytical data products.

DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES
Data Management, Scientific Analysis, and Software Programming (50%)

• Performs data-management, computational, and bioinformatics assignments supporting research in tropical biology, ecology, and forestry.

• Develops, implements, modifies, and maintains data-processing pipelines used to process plot-based tree inventory and related ecological data and to derive estimates such as forest woody biomass density.

• Evaluates the performance of existing data-processing pipelines and recommends modifications or improvements based on data characteristics, analytical requirements, user needs, and experience working with ForestGEO and GEO-TREES site teams.

• Develops and modifies computational procedures for analysis of ForestGEO and GEO-TREES scientific data using established data-science principles, methods, and practices.

• Processes, validates, organizes, and manages tree inventory, Global Navigation Satellite System (GNSS), Airborne Laser Scanning (ALS), and Terrestrial Laser Scanning (TLS) data for scientific analysis and long-term storage.

• Supports the archiving and long-term management of scientific datasets to ensure appropriate organization, documentation, accessibility, and usability.

• Develops and maintains data-management solutions and informatics workflows for data acquisition, formatting, validation, processing, analysis, use, and storage.

• Implements established data standards and contributes to the development and modification of data structures and architectures appropriate to assigned projects.

• Writes, tests, documents, troubleshoots, and maintains computer code used in data-processing and analytical workflows.

• Uses programming languages and tools such as R, Python, SQL, Git, GitHub, GIS applications, and related scientific and data-management software.

• Identifies data-quality problems, inconsistencies, missing values, formatting issues, and other anomalies and determines appropriate methods for correcting or documenting them.

• Works with researchers and other technical personnel to ensure that processed data and analyticalproducts meet established scientific and program requirements.

Requirements Gathering and Technical Support (25%)

• Works closely with researchers and program personnel to identify data-processing, analytical, software, and data-management requirements for assigned scientific projects.

• Conducts technical analyses of available methods and alternatives and recommends appropriate software tools, workflows, calculations, and analytical approaches.

• Assists researchers in translating scientific requirements into practical data-processing and

• computational solutions.

• Evaluates existing workflows and recommends modifications when established approaches do not fully address the characteristics of the data or requirements of an assigned project.

• Coordinates with site representatives concerning timelines and technical requirements for acquisition and submission of plot inventory, TLS, ALS, GNSS, and related scientific data.

• Reviews submitted data to determine whether established ForestGEO and GEO-TREES formatting, documentation, and data-quality requirements have been met.

• Works with site personnel to resolve routine and moderately complex data-submission and data-quality problems.

• Coordinates with the Office of the Chief Information Officer (OCIO) and other appropriate technical staff to ensure assigned development activities follow applicable systems-development, documentation, version-control, security, and software-development practices.

• Prepares technical documentation describing data-processing workflows, code, data structures, analytical procedures, and related methods.

• Assists in testing new or modified software tools, workflows, and procedures prior to implementation.

Training and Collaboration (25%)

• Develops and provides formal and informal training to researchers, site personnel, and program partners concerning ForestGEO and GEO-TREES data systems, data-management procedures, formatting requirements, data-processing workflows, and related tools.

• Serves as a technical point of contact for tree-inventory teams and other users at assigned ForestGEO and GEO-TREES sites.

• Provides advice, training, troubleshooting assistance, and technical support concerning data collection, formatting, cleaning, validation, processing, documentation, and submission.

• Explains data standards, analytical procedures, software requirements, and data-management practices to researchers and partners with varying levels of technical expertise.

• Collaborates with scientists, data managers, programmers, and other personnel to identify and resolve data-management and processing problems.

• Participates in meetings, working groups, and collaborative activities involving ForestGEO, GEO-TREES, Smithsonian staff, and domestic and international research partners.

• Shares information concerning lessons learned, recurring data problems, workflow improvements, and effective data-management practices with program staff and partners.

Performs other duties as assigned.

Education and Experience:

• Professional knowledge of and skill in applying a wide range of data-science principles, concepts, methods, and practices sufficient to perform difficult data-management, processing, computational, and analytical assignments involving ecological and forestry data.

• Knowledge of data acquisition, data cleaning, validation, transformation, integration, storage, analysis, visualization, documentation, and reproducible computational workflows.

• Knowledge of computational and data-management methods is required to develop, modify, implement, and maintain processing pipelines for tree inventory, GNSS, ALS, TLS, spatial, and related scientific datasets.

• Knowledge of programming concepts and skill in applying programming languages and analytical tools such as R, Python, SQL, Git, GitHub, and related software to manipulate, process, analyze, and manage scientific data.

• Knowledge of algorithm development, software testing, version control, debugging, documentation, deployment, and maintenance practices is required to support scientific applications and data-processing workflows.

• Knowledge of spatial-data concepts, common spatial-data formats, and GIS software is required to process and evaluate geospatial information associated with ForestGEO and GEO-TREES projects.

• Knowledge of the scientific concepts associated with ecology, tropical biology, forestry, or related environmental sciences sufficient to understand data characteristics, research requirements, analytical objectives, and the relationships among data variables.

As a Data Scientist for Choice's Revenue Management Agentic Systems and Pricing Analytics team, you will use AI, data science, and revenue management expertise to solve pricing, forecasting, and commercial performance questions at the brand, market, and hotel/property level. Technical Skills

Additional Skills & Competencies

• Strong strategic and critical thinking skills, with the ability to draw conclusions from data and translate analytical findings into RM and pricing recommendations.

We hire people who want that level of responsibility. People who move fast, think critically, act like owners, and care deeply about solving customer problems with precision. Job Summary:
Socure is the leading provider of digital identity verification and fraud prevention solutions, using AI and machine learning to power accurate identity trust decisions. Our mission is to eliminate identity fraud and ensure online trust across industries.
We are seeking a Data Scientist II to join our Digital Intelligence team. In this role, you will develop machine learning features, analytical methods, and production-oriented risk signals using device, network, browser, mobile, API, session, and behavioral telemetry.
This is a hands-on role for a data scientist who can independently deliver well-scoped projects, work with complex and noisy data, and partner with engineering, product, and risk teams to improve fraud detection, identity confidence, and customer outcomes. You will deepen your expertise in Digital Intelligence while contributing to models and signals used in real-world production decisions.
Job Responsibilities:
• Develop machine learning features, models, and analytical methods for device, network, browser, mobile, session, and behavioral intelligence.

• Work on scoped fraud and identity risk problems where data quality, labels, telemetry coverage, and product tradeoffs need careful analysis.

• Build features from large-scale, high-cardinality, sparse, noisy, and platform-dependent telemetry.

• Analyze signal patterns such as spoofing, emulator behavior, automation, proxy/VPN usage, low-entropy fingerprints, telemetry gaps, and device or session fragmentation.

• Design and execute validation analyses, including train/test splits, holdout checks, leakage review, drift assessment, customer impact analysis, and feature stability review.

• Use supervised, unsupervised, statistical, and heuristic approaches to identify durable fraud and identity risk signals.

• Investigate imperfect labels, delayed outcomes, instrumentation gaps, and changing fraud patterns to distinguish useful signal from data artifacts.

• Partner with senior data scientists, engineering, product, risk, and platform teams to clarify requirements, prepare data, implement features, and support production rollout.

• Contribute to model documentation, feature definitions, explainability materials, dashboards, and production-readiness reviews.

• Communicate methods, assumptions, findings, limitations, and recommendations clearly to technical and cross-functional stakeholders.

• Support junior data scientists and analysts through code review, analytical feedback, and sharing effective modeling and validation practices.

Job Requirements:
• Bachelor's, Master's, or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Statistics, Mathematics, Data Science, or a related quantitative field, or equivalent practical experience.

• 5+ years of experience in data science, applied machine learning, statistical modeling, analytics engineering, or a related technical role.

• Experience building, evaluating, and improving machine learning models, features, analytical pipelines, or risk signals.

• Strong SQL skills and experience working with large-scale, complex datasets.

• Strong proficiency in Python and experience with data science libraries such as pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn, XGBoost, TensorFlow, PyTorch, or similar.

• Experience with distributed data processing tools such as Spark, PySpark, Databricks, or equivalent frameworks.

• Solid understanding of supervised learning, unsupervised learning, feature engineering, model evaluation, statistical validation, and experiment analysis.

• Ability to work with noisy data, imperfect labels, missing values, instrumentation gaps, and changing data distributions.

• Strong analytical judgment across data quality, feature design, model selection, explainability, and business impact.

• Experience collaborating with engineering, product, analytics, or risk teams to move data science work toward production or operational use.

• Clear communication skills, including the ability to explain technical work, assumptions, tradeoffs, and results to non-specialist stakeholders.

• Ability to operate independently on defined problem areas while seeking guidance appropriately on ambiguous or high-risk decisions.

Preferred Qualifications:
